COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Leadership Development is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Leadership Development as rumours only.
   B. Say Leadership Development never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

3. Which statement about Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im.

4. Which statement about Building Consensus is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Building Consensus as rumours only.
   B. Explain Building Consensus with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Building Consensus.
   D. Say Building Consensus never happens in Kenya.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

6. Which statement about Advocacy in the School Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Advocacy in the School Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Advocacy in the School Community as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Advocacy in the School Community.
   D. Say Advocacy in the School Community never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Intercultural Competence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Intercultural Competence as rumours only.
   B. Say Intercultural Competence never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Intercultural Competence.
   D. Explain Intercultural Competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte.
   C. Explain Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte as rumours only.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

10. Which statement about Nurturing Empathy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Nurturing Empathy.
   B. Explain Nurturing Empathy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Nurturing Empathy as rumours only.
   D. Say Nurturing Empathy never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Civic Dialogue is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Civic Dialogue with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Civic Dialogue never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Civic Dialogue as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Civic Dialogue.

12. Which statement about Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr as rumours only.
   C. Say Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Intercultural Competence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Nurturing Empathy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Negotiation Skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
